spec.question: does TRND-1's rule, unchanged, still earn a positive net return with a smaller worst fall than holding the four index CFDs, on months that did not exist when it was chosen?
spec.rule: TRND-1's, unchanged: at each month-end close, hold each index for the next month if the close is above the mean of its last 10 month-end closes (this one included), otherwise hold nothing for it; the four at equal weight; a calendar month without a close is never bridged
spec.t: no t gate: 36 months cannot show significance. The check is whether the validated rule still earns and still protects, as its holdout's was
